svg.title: Zyad Mohamed · Cybersecurity Command Center
svg.desc: Role: Cybersecurity student. Focus: Mobile defense · Automation. Stack: Python · No-code. Interests: Network security · Machine learning. Location: Egypt. Status: Building · Learning. 4 commits, 6 public repositories, 0 pull requests opened, and 6 stars. Original hooded portrait rendered using monospace characters.
